text: Make 'athena check --history' (or the same check in the gate) a required check before Athena lands a candidate whose change touches record-validation or scoring rules, or the landing logic in crates/athena-gate, so that history breakage is caught before landing rather than in CI. Job 20261010-154004-60r4 changed a scoring rule and failed the history check in its PR's CI. The fix job 20261017-121143-sg0j then landed and failed the same check on main. Its request named this gating as a separate, unqueued request.
